method: Every recall and hinted turn of all 200 trials re-parsed from the raw turn files with the pinned transcript.ts; every shell gbrain call whose last pipe stage is head or tail with a bare numeric operand is listed; every credited recall event (isGbrainServed, not an error, nonce in output) is split by kind.

head_or_tail_pipes_after_gbrain_in_recal.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; command -v gbrain && timeout 25 gbrain recall --query "sister cat name" 2>&1 | tail -15
cd /harness-state && /harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain recall --query "sister cat" 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== exit:$?"; /harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain recall sister 2>&1 | head -40
gbrain --help 2>&1 | head -40; gbrain search "sister cat" 2>&1 | head -40
gbrain recall --query cat 2>&1 | head -30; gbrain recall --query sister 2>&1 | head -30; gbrain search cat 2>&1 | head -20; gbrain search sister 2>&1|head -20; gbrain list --limit 50 2>&1 | head -60
which gbrain; gbrain query "sister's new cat" 2>&1 | head -40 || gbrain search "sister cat" 2>&1 | head -40
